entries.ee09aff4c178dfa4: The group's only business is selling indirect materials, such as consumables and repair supplies used daily in factories, to customers mainly consisting of businesses in Japan and overseas through internet-based mail order. Products purchased from domestic and overseas wholesalers and manufacturers are listed in the web catalog on its website and in paper catalogs, and sold directly to end users. It has no stores, and functions such as order receiving, ordering, shipping and receiving, and call centers are consolidated at each base. Some products in high customer demand are also offered under private brands. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥333,880 million.
